purpose: Teach: 辞める/肩書き/党内/プロダクト/親会社/やりがい/チャネル/紛失

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、本気で、絶対、辞める、絶対、ことなく、絶対、続けろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — keep your research going. Don't you dare quit on me. I'm serious.
lines.style: Direct, steady, fatherly weight behind it. Not harsh—measured. The tone of someone who knows Ren's prone to self-doubt. A command wrapped in care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学位の、本気で、絶対、肩書き、絶対、誇りに、絶対、思っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm truly grateful for this opportunity and for the credentials this will give me.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not robotic. A slight catch of emotion—he means it. Careful enunciation, sincere pace. The gratitude is real, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学界の、本気で、絶対、党内、絶対、なような、絶対、派閥、絶対、巻き込まれるな、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — don't get caught up in academic politics. Stay clear of the factions. That's an order.
lines.style: Firmer now. A warning wrapped in directive. Brief pause after the first name—he's making sure Ren is listening. Protective, not paranoid.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究、本気で、絶対、プロダクト、絶対、化、絶対、検討しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm thinking carefully about how to make this research into something with real market value.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. He's showing he's considered this seriously. Not defensive—just clarifying his position. Steady breathing, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、業界、本気で、絶対、親会社、絶対、と、絶対、研究、絶対、関係、絶対、紹介しよう、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I'm going to introduce you to some people in industry, get your research connected with the right parent companies.
lines.style: Assured, generous. This is Hiroshi showing he believes in Ren and is actively helping. Open tone, almost warm beneath the directive. Confident in what he's offering.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究、本気で、絶対、やりがい、絶対、を、絶対、感じております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm finding real meaning and fulfillment in this work. Thank you for that chance.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. A moment of genuine emotion breaking through the formal register. Slightly slower, breathing space between thoughts. The gratitude lands because it's unguarded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文発表の、本気で、絶対、チャネル、絶対、広げろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — expand your channels for publishing. Get your papers out there. Broader reach.
lines.style: Practical, strategic. Less emotion here—this is tactical advice. Short, clean sentences. Confident and matter-of-fact, like he's handing Ren the keys to the next step.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文、本気で、絶対、紛失、絶対、なきよう、絶対、バックアップしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm backing up everything carefully—I won't lose a single paper to carelessness.
lines.style: Earnest, almost protective of the work. A small smile in the voice—he gets it, the paranoia about losing research. Final affirmation with closure. Respectful exhale at the end.
